# plan 2026-09-30-qwen7b-serving-pp1
# local results -> /runs/2026-09-30-qwen7b-serving-pp1
# [sync] mkdir node0
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
mkdir -p "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/bench" "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-09-30-qwen7b-serving-pp1"
LAB_EOF
# [sync] copy bench scripts to node0
scp -q /src/tools/lab/remote/bench_latency.py /src/tools/lab/remote/probe_env.py node0:inference-sim-lab/bench/
# [clean] stop stale processes on node0
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
pkill -f '[b]ench_latency.py' || true; pkill -f '[v]llm bench serve' || true; pkill -f '[v]llm serve' || true; pkill -f '[V]LLM::' || true; docker rm -f lab-2026-09-30-qwen7b-serving-pp1 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/.venv/bin/ray" stop --force >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
LAB_EOF
# [preflight] probe node0 -> probe-node0.json
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
docker run --rm --runtime=nvidia -e NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all --ipc=host --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HF_HOME="/hf" -e HOME="/tmp" -e VLLM_CACHE_ROOT="/tmp/vllm-cache" -e PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1" -e CUDA_HOME="/usr/local/cuda" -v "$HOME/.cache/huggingface:/hf" -v "$HOME/inference-sim-lab:/lab" --entrypoint python3 vllm/vllm-openai:v0.29.0 /lab/bench/probe_env.py
LAB_EOF
# [launch] start vllm serve
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
docker run -d --name lab-2026-09-30-qwen7b-serving-pp1 --runtime=nvidia -e NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all --ipc=host --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HF_HOME="/hf" -e HOME="/tmp" -e VLLM_CACHE_ROOT="/tmp/vllm-cache" -e PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1" -e CUDA_HOME="/usr/local/cuda" -v "$HOME/.cache/huggingface:/hf" -v "$HOME/inference-sim-lab:/lab" -p 127.0.0.1:8000:8000 vllm/vllm-openai:v0.29.0 --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct --dtype bfloat16 --max-model-len 4096 --max-num-batched-tokens 2048 --max-num-seqs 64 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 --no-enable-prefix-caching --seed 0
LAB_EOF
# [wait] server ready (poll until complete=1, expected=1, timeout=900s)
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
if curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8000/health >/dev/null; then c=1; else c=0; fi; if [ -n "$(docker ps -q --filter name=^lab-2026-09-30-qwen7b-serving-pp1$)" ]; then a=1; else a=0; fi; echo "complete=$c progress=$c alive=$a"
LAB_EOF
# [launch] bench serve rate=1
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
cd "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-09-30-qwen7b-serving-pp1" || exit 1
nohup env PATH="$HOME/inference-sim-lab/.venv/bin:$PATH" HF_HOME="$HOME/.cache/huggingface" NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME="bond0" GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME="bond0" VLLM_HOST_IP="10.1.1.69" PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1" CUDA_HOME="/usr/local/cuda" vllm bench serve --backend vllm --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct --dataset-name random --random-input-len 512 --random-output-len 128 --random-range-ratio 0 --ignore-eos --num-prompts 200 --request-rate 1 --seed 0 --disable-tqdm --percentile-metrics ttft,tpot,itl,e2el --metric-percentiles 50,90,99 --save-result --result-dir "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-09-30-qwen7b-serving-pp1" --result-filename rate_1.json > "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-09-30-qwen7b-serving-pp1/bench_rate_1.log" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
LAB_EOF
# [wait] bench serve rate=1 (poll until complete=1, expected=1, timeout=3600s)
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
if [ -s "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-09-30-qwen7b-serving-pp1/rate_1.json" ]; then c=1; else c=0; fi; if pgrep -f '[v]llm bench serve.*rate_1.json' >/dev/null; then a=1; else a=0; fi; echo "complete=$c progress=$c alive=$a"
LAB_EOF
